faq.q: What is a before and after video?
faq.a: It is a short clip with a starting state, one practical action, and a visible result. You make it from one product photo and use it as a product demonstration.

faq.q: How do I make one from a product photo?
faq.a: Upload one clear photo of the whole item, describe the start, the action, and the result, pick a frame and a length, then download the clip.

faq.q: How is this different from filming two setups?
faq.a: A shoot stages the item twice and tries to match the camera. Here both states are directed from the same photo, in minutes, with no second booking.

faq.q: Who should use a before and after video?
faq.a: Sellers whose product fixes something visible, such as a stain, dust, loose cords, or a stuck zipper. It suits a product page or a paid ad.

faq.q: What should the clip not claim?
faq.a: Show a change to an item or the space around it, not a health, skin, or body result. A cleaned shoe, a routed cable, or a dust-free shelf should match what the product really does.

faq.q: Which frames and lengths can I choose?
faq.a: Choose 9:16, 1:1, 16:9, 4:3, or 3:4, and 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds. Downloads have no watermark.

faq.q: How many credits does one clip use?
faq.a: A 6-second clip uses 24 credits, 10 seconds uses 40, 15 seconds uses 60, and 30 seconds uses 120. The cost shows before you start, and a failed job gives the credits back.

faq.q: Can I add Before and After labels?
faq.a: Yes. Add them in your editor after download, so the words stay spelled the way you want.

faq.q: Can I add captions, a price, or music?
faq.a: Yes. Add captions, your price, and licensed music in your editor. This tool does not add them for you.

faq.q: Is anyone on screen a real customer?
faq.a: No. Any person in the clip is generated for the ad, not a buyer. Do not present the result as a customer review.

faq.q: Will TikTok or Meta reject this kind of AI ad?
faq.a: They do not ban AI ads as a class. Some require a label when a clip could be read as a real customer. Check the current rule before you scale spend.

definition.title: What Is an AI Before and After Video?
paras: An AI before and after video shows one starting state, one practical action, and one visible result, made from a single product photo. The item and the camera stay steady so a shopper can judge the change.

Use it as a transformation video for ads on TikTok, Reels, Shorts, or a product page. Frames are 9:16, 1:1, 16:9, 4:3, and 3:4. The change has to be something your product really does to an item or the space around it, not a health, skin, or body result.
